name: Dynamic AI Helper Prompts
purpose: Define quick consultation prompts and the active finding signals that make each prompt relevant. These are navigation aids, not evidence or diagnostic rules.
do_not_claim: A helper prompt is a relevance hint based on selected packs and active callable findings; it does not establish a disease, trait, anatomy, identity, hormone level, medication response, or personal risk.
Missing or uncalled markers do not activate or deactivate a clinical conclusion, and helper text cannot override marker claim boundaries, evidence tiers, or clinical confirmation requirements.

helpers.label: 🍎 Metabolic & Methylation Summary
helpers.text: Explain my active metabolic and nutrient methylation findings in simple, clear terms.

helpers.label: ☕ Histamine & Caffeine Lifestyle
helpers.text: What lifestyle or dietary topics should I discuss with my doctor based on my histamine and caffeine markers?

helpers.label: 🥗 Food & Supplement Safety
helpers.text: Help me review food and supplement questions raised by my active findings, including labs, allergies, medications, and what I should avoid assuming from DNA.

helpers.label: 🏃 Activity & Recovery Context
helpers.text: Help me turn my active performance, connective-tissue, bone, or sleep findings into cautious activity and recovery questions for a clinician or coach.

helpers.label: 💊 PGx Drug Variations Guide
helpers.text: Help me draft a simple summary of my active pharmacogenomic (PGx) variations to share with my doctor or pharmacist.

helpers.label: 🌸 Hormone & Reproductive Context
helpers.text: Help me review active hormone and reproductive context markers alongside symptom timing, exact medication ingredients, and appropriate clinical follow-up—without inferring current hormone levels or a diagnosis.

helpers.label: ⚠️ Clinical vs Standard Traits
helpers.text: Explain the difference between variants requiring clinical confirmation (like high-stakes cancer markers) and standard traits.

helpers.label: 🧬 Genomic Overview
helpers.text: Give me a high-level summary of the active marker findings in my profile and what they mean.
